text: 根据特朗普8月的财务披露显示，他买入的Meta股票金额最高达2500万美元，同时买入SpaceX债务的金额最高达500万美元。他买入SpaceX债务的时间，是在他签署一项旨在扩大美国商业航天运输政策的两天前。特朗普8月交易依然活跃，报告了517笔买入和卖出交易。（CNBC）
text_en: According to Trump's August financial disclosure, his Meta stock purchases amounted to as much as $25 million, while his purchases of SpaceX debt amounted to as much as $5 million. He bought the SpaceX debt two days before signing a policy aimed at expanding US commercial space transportation. Trump remained active in August trading, reporting 517 buy and sell transactions. (CNBC)
